request: mix: CSVの列数ずれ・重複行・前後空白を検査して報告する / ファイルまたは標準入力からCSVを読み、問題を行番号つきで1行ずつ報告する。検査項目は、ヘッダと列数が違う行、完全に同じ内容の重複行（行内容のUUID v5で判定し最初の行番号を示す）、セルの前後の空白、空のセル、ヘッダ名の重複。例: 3行目が列数不足、5行目が2行目と重複なら `3: 列数が4でなく3` `5: 2行目と重複` のように出し、問題があれば終了コード1、なければ何も出さず0。フラグは -k（重複判定に使う列番号をカンマ区切りで指定）のみ。コマンド名は csvcheck

spec.name: csvcheck
spec.summary: csvcheck reads CSV from a file or stdin and reports structural problems line by line, exiting 1 if any are found.

flags.name: k
flags.help: comma-separated 1-based column numbers used for duplicate row detection (default: whole row)

behavior: B1: Input is the single file argument, or stdin if no argument is given. More than one argument is a usage error: print "usage: csvcheck [-k cols] [file]" to stderr, exit 2.

B2: Parse with encoding/csv, FieldsPerRecord = -1, default quote rules. The line number of a record is the physical line where it starts (csv.Reader.FieldPos(0) line); the first record is the header. Blank lines are skipped by the parser.
B3: Empty input (no records): print nothing, exit 0.

B4: If -k is given, split it on commas; each item must be an integer from 1 to the header column count, otherwise print "csvcheck: invalid -k value: <the whole -k string>" to stderr and exit 2 before any problem is printed (checked right after the header is read). Repeated numbers are allowed.

B5: Problems are printed to stdout as found, one per line, as "<line>: <message>", in record order. Within one record the order is: column count, duplicate header names (header only), cells left to right, duplicate row (data rows only).
B6: Column count: if a data record has C fields and the header has H, print "<line>: 列数がHでなくC" with decimal numbers, e.g. "3: 列数が4でなく3".
B7: Duplicate header names: for each header cell whose exact text equals an earlier header cell, print "<line>: ヘッダ名「NAME」が重複" where NAME is the cell text.

B8: Cells (header and data rows, columns numbered from 1 over the fields actually present): if a cell differs from strings.TrimSpace(cell), print "<line>: 列Nのセルの前後に空白"; otherwise if the cell is the empty string, print "<line>: 列Nのセルが空". Only one message per cell.

B9: Duplicate rows (data rows only): key = the selected -k fields (a missing field counts as empty string) or all fields, joined with the byte 0x1F; id = uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte(key)). If id was seen before, print "<line>: M行目と重複" where M is the line of the first record with that id. Short or long rows take part like any other row.
B10: Exit 1 if anything was printed to stdout. Open/read failure or CSV parse error: print "csvcheck: <error text>" to stderr and exit 1 (problems already printed stay printed). Otherwise exit 0.

stdout.exact:
3: 列数が4でなく3
5: 2行目と重複

2: 列1のセルの前後に空白
2: 列2のセルが空
